findings.title: returnTo accepts a backslash-prefixed off-site path
findings.detail: safeAppRedirectPath accepts '/\\evil.com'; the WHATWG URL parser treats a backslash as a slash for special schemes, so window.location.assign resolves it to https://evil.com/. Verified locally on Node v22. This is the sign-in returnTo path the internal gate redirects unauthenticated users into.
findings.acceptanceCriterionViolated: returnTo accepts safe local internal paths only
findings.candidateTestGap: scripts/verify-internal-admin-browser-access.mjs asserts 'returnTo accepts safe local paths only' but covers only //, absolute URLs and scheme prefixes
findings.suggestedCorrection: reject any value containing a backslash or control character and extend the unsafe-value table in the focused suite

findings.title: remediation receipt defaults into a tracked repository directory
findings.detail: default receipt path artifacts/security/internal-admin-remediation-<mode>-<timestamp>.json sits inside the tracked, non-gitignored artifacts/ tree and contains production emails and both production Auth UUIDs. Mitigated by 0600 mode, wx flag, an explicit do-not-commit warning, and a runbook that always passes --receipt.
findings.suggestedCorrection: require --receipt in apply mode or default outside the repository, and/or gitignore artifacts/security/

findings.title: COMMAND_CENTER_API_KEY inventory is incomplete
findings.detail: the bearer key still authorizes GET /api/metrics/signups (aggregate counts only, outside /internal). The audit record describes the key's scope as /api/internal/analytics/summary only.

findings.title: candidate makes npm test red at the verifier-disposition gate, and the new suites are unwired
findings.detail: npm test fails at scripts/verify-rcap-verifier-dispositions.mjs with "no recorded disposition" for scripts/test-internal-admin-rls-hardening.mjs and scripts/verify-internal-admin-security-tools.mjs. data/rcap-verifier-dispositions.json is byte-identical between base and candidate (blob c5e83a9f0f12831540abb5deef240940a46a384e) and has no entry for either newly added script. The base tree passes the same verifier 340/340. The gate runs before the Phase 52 suites, so npm test never reaches them. The same omission means the RLS boundary suite and the remediation-tool guardrails do not run in CI: test-internal-admin-rls-hardening.mjs has an npm alias but no caller, verify-internal-admin-security-tools.mjs has neither.
findings.suggestedCorrection: run npm run rcap:generate-verifier-dispositions, record a deliberate disposition for both scripts, and wire security:test-internal-admin-rls into the default gate

findings.title: POST /sign-out has no same-origin check
findings.detail: cross-site form submission can force a sign-out; impact is limited and fail-safe, but asymmetric with the invite route's isSameOriginRequest check

findings.title: /internal is no longer refused at the edge on public product hosts
findings.detail: removing the proxy authority means /internal renders the server-side denial on expungement.ai, legalease.com, legalease.law and cleartherecord.org instead of a proxy 401. Authorization is unaffected and noindex plus no-store are applied, but the removed host-scoping assertions were not replaced

findings.title: non-internal content roles lose all CMS access
findings.detail: editor, legal_reviewer, social_manager, contributor and partner_contributor rows no longer grant any privileged access at either layer. Documented as intended in the blast-radius review; confirm during staging that no live content operator depends on one

findings.title: vacuous zero-administrator check
findings.detail: plannedActive.size < 1 can never be true because the corporate UUID is unconditionally added first; lockout protection actually rests on the corporate active-administrator precondition
